_note: Receipt outputs (Ausgaben eines Belegs). `outputs`: `input` is `data.outputs` of a getReceipt answer as received; `expected` is the list the package reads from it (null when it is no list; an entry without non-empty text kind, at and result is dropped; by is {id, name} with name null when not text, or null without a non-empty text id; count only as a safe whole number from 0; unknown kind or result kept), `labels` is receiptOutputLabel of each expected entry (null for an unknown kind; opened without a whole count from 1 counts as 1). `requests`: `entries` as given to logReceiptOutputs; `expected.sent` is the request body (without cashregisterId, which the sign-in adds), or `expected.error` the rejection before sending (scope request, reason of the first failing check; an unknown field reads `entries[i]: unbekanntes Feld "<name>"`). Written by `npm run fixtures:ausgaben`.
